# KH: Khandala office trip: reel + carousel

Srijan Jaiswal (own) · own ·  · notes: 

**Core lesson:** What we actually produced: an 18 s silent reel cut every 1.5 s with linear pans, a warm ffmpeg grade and serif-italic text, plus a 10-slide carousel and Hinglish/English copy.


## Ideas from this source (19)

- **[Office-trip content gets sent to colleagues](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-workplace-trip-shareable)** · ideas: Workplace-trip content is highly shareable because people DM it to colleagues ("we need this trip"); the Khandala caption CTA asks to send it to the colleague who always says "next time".
- **[Name the exact spot everywhere](../topics/ideas.md#ideas-place-specific-seo)** · ideas: Use the place plus the exact viewpoint in on-screen text, caption and location tag ("Khandala Lonavala" pairs well since people search both).
- **[End on a frame that loops](../topics/editing.md#edit-loop-to-frame-1)** · editing: Loopable edits win on watch time; the Khandala reel ends back on the sun and feet so it loops to frame 1.
- **[Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion)** · editing: Our edit blueprint sets cut rules (on the beat or on motion) and travel uses a wide → close-up rhythm. Khandala cut every 1.5 s, which lands on 80 and 120 BPM beats (2 or 3 beats per shot), so music could be added later.
- **[Cull near-duplicates; keep the strongest](../topics/editing.md#edit-cull-near-duplicates)** · editing: Khandala: 43 raw files to 1 reel + 1 carousel; dropped near-duplicates, tilted horizons, soft digital zooms, litter in frame and harsh midday light that broke the sunset look.
- **[Face check before using any frame](../topics/editing.md#edit-face-check)** · editing: Never use frames where the mouth is open or mid-word, the tongue shows, eyes are mid-blink or the angle is awkward; prefer a clear smile, a confident neutral or a candid look-away. The Khandala profile shot was replaced after this feedback.
- **[Export silent; pick a low-use track in-app](../topics/sound.md#sound-low-use-count-track)** · sound: Khandala was exported silent and the music chosen in Edits with the use count checked (under ~10K uses is ideal); a place-name song adds nostalgia. Our early edits went out silent this way (L02).
- **[Khandala pans and push-ins were linear](../topics/effects.md#fx-khandala-linear-moves)** · effects: Khandala animates its photos with slow pans and push-ins (sun to subject, cliff + cactus), but our ffmpeg build moved them at constant speed (linear), the opposite of L03's rule.
- **[Pan to reveal the subject](../topics/transitions.md#tr-pan-reveal)** · transitions: Khandala opens on a pan to the sun with feet coming into frame, then pans from sun to subject and reveals the peak.
- **[Serif italic emphasis + sans body](../topics/text.md#text-serif-italic-emphasis)** · text: Emphasis words in serif italic (*pro*, *honest*), body in clean sans, keyword highlights in yellow/orange. Our Khandala reel used Instrument Serif Italic.
- **[Caption: hook line, story, CTA, 3–5 tags](../topics/text.md#text-caption-structure)** · text: Line 1 = hook/keyword line visible before "more"; 1–3 lines of story or value; a CTA (send/save); 3–5 hashtags. Khandala used a Hinglish chill reel caption and an English story carousel caption.
- **[Keywords in caption and text over hashtags](../topics/text.md#text-seo-over-hashtags)** · text: Keyword-rich captions and on-screen text ("Khandala sunset point") over hashtags; 3–5 precise hashtags; add alt text, location tag, collaborator tags and a first-comment idea.
- **[Hinglish voice and captions](../topics/text.md#text-hinglish-voice)** · text: Rahul speaks Hindi/Hinglish with English or Hinglish on-screen captions; our caption voice switches between English and Hinglish by theme (Khandala reel: Hinglish, chill).
- **[Khandala grade recipe in ffmpeg](../topics/colour.md#colour-khandala-ffmpeg-grade)** · colour: Gentle S-curve, warm mids/highlights (R +0.03), saturation 1.10, contrast 1.04, light vignette.
- **[Ask before posting faces](../topics/filming.md#film-consent-faces)** · filming: Get a yes from everyone visible before posting or tagging; Khandala media stays outside the repo because colleagues appear in it.
- **[Collab posts bring new audiences](../topics/growth.md#growth-collab-pillar)** · growth: A regular collaborator making about 4 collab posts a month brings a new audience; our Khandala carousel was planned as a Collab with a colleague, and tags add reach via their networks.
- **[First 60 minutes after posting](../topics/growth.md#growth-first-60-minutes)** · growth: Share to Stories with a sticker/poll (Khandala: a "Guess the point?" poll), reply to every comment, DM it to a few friends who'd enjoy it.
- **[Default posting windows (IST)](../topics/growth.md#growth-posting-windows-ist)** · growth: Weekdays 7–9 PM, lunch 12:30–2 PM, weekends 10 AM–12 PM and 6–9 PM, to be replaced by own Insights; Khandala reel planned Thu 7:30 PM, carousel Sun 8 PM.
- **[Specs: 9:16 reels, 4:5 or 3:4 feed](../topics/growth.md#growth-format-specs)** · growth: Reels 1080×1920, 30 fps (60 for slow-mo sources), HDR off unless the phone's HDR uploads well; feed/carousel 4:5 1080×1350 or the 3:4 grid crop (Khandala carousel 1080×1440).
